messages.subject: WC-00115 Sutherland v Vantage - approach
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom, Elena,

Thoughts on Sutherland. Two limbs: (1) the debt - £487,250 of unpaid Feb/Mar/Apr invoices, which looks unanswerable; (2) wrongful termination - they purported to terminate "for convenience" but clause 13.1 only allows termination for unremedied material breach or insolvency.

Let's get a letter before action out under the Pre-Action Protocol giving 21 days. Tom, please draft. Elena, can you start pulling the chronology and the loss figures from the management accounts - I want the schedule of loss to tie exactly to the guaranteed-minimum mechanism in clause 7.4.

Sarah

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0000 | www.whitfieldcarter.com
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
